subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed gated Claw package, hosted-feed, and lifecycle contract before the linked Claws RFC is accepted and the predecessor stack is approved?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but they cannot decide whether ClawHub should create durable package-family, manifest, feed, ownership, and upgrade contracts for complete-agent distribution.

options.title: Keep draft until contract approval
options.body: Accept or narrow the RFC, review the predecessor layers, and require live lifecycle proof before rebasing and landing this feed layer.

options.title: Approve coordinated experimental landing
options.body: Explicitly accept the gated compatibility and security boundaries, then land the complete stack in a maintainer-controlled order after proof is supplied.

options.title: Decline the hosted package direction
options.body: Close the implementation stack if complete-agent packages should not become a ClawHub registry contract.

recommendation.title: Keep draft until contract approval
recommendation.body: Accept or narrow the RFC, review the predecessor layers, and require live lifecycle proof before rebasing and landing this feed layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged hosted-feed architecture most directly affected by the new package and feed contract.
